Foodies heaven
Apr 2026 • Couples
This is the restaurant of the Hanoi Pearl Hotel in Old Town where we stayed during our stop here. 
We wanted light, fresh and substantial after a long day out and about. 
We ordered the fried spring rolls, grilled fish and lemongrass chicken. 
Foodies heaven!! 
The staff went above and beyond to make our night relaxing and special. 
Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavour. Tastebuds still dancing. 
Highly recommended!
